text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 13 · 沙漠白石议事庭.
Environment:  An original desert civilization's intimate council courtyard carved into pale cream sandstone, thick clean geometric walls, shallow inset niches, broad monumental doorway framing distant pale dunes. Low circular stone seating and a small rectangular dry raked-sand garden offset right, sparse natural grasses in one earthen vessel. Large diffuse skylight and generous reflected fill make all shadows soft and readable. Eye-level human scale despite substantial architectural forms, tactile hand-finished stone and fine windblown dust. Architecture grows from geology; no thrones, weapons, insignia, statues or orange apocalyptic grading.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 13 · 沙漠白石议事庭. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
